integrity: Analytic all-rate theorem with independently constructed finite-state generator checks; no external certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: The comparison excludes only the matching nearest-neighbor zero-field equilibrium law, not all Gibbs representations.
No finite-sample or experimental robustness theorem.
Uniform simultaneous resets to a freshly resampled iid fair-sign configuration are essential.
title: A fourth-order obstruction to equilibrium camouflage in a globally reinitialized Glauber chain
